note: Workers AI models for development and debugging, checked before every call by eval/_kit/llm.py (backend=rest) and the writer-faithfulness prototype. Set 2026-10-04 from the Cloudflare model catalog and pricing page plus our own readings (the sentence-check agent on dev-1 / dev-2). Tiers: dev = the default for iteration; cheap-weak = fast and cheap, judgement too weak to check a sentence alone, keep for narrow sub-tasks; paid-cheap = cheap but a paid model, 20 requests/min per model; core = expensive, only for core capability nodes, needs ALLOW_CORE=1; production = what production calls today, fine for replaying production steps, not as an agent; blocked = refused. A model not listed needs ALLOW_UNLISTED=1 (qualification runs only). price = USD per million tokens [input, cached input, output].
